Candidates are advised to possess or acquire a valid Aadhaar card, as Online Aadhaar verification will be conducted at various stages. Mobile phones, pagers, calculators, or similar devices are not allowed inside the examination premises. Selected candidates will be posted within the state applied for the first 12 years of service or until promotion to SMGS-IV grade, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates will be on probation for 12 months from the date of joining. Selected candidates must execute a Service Bond to serve a minimum of 3 years, or pay an amount equivalent to three months' gross salary (not exceeding Rs. 2 Lakhs) if they leave before completing three years of service. Any legal disputes arising from this recruitment fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of courts/tribunals in Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: BOB Local Bank Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda has announced a total of 2482 vacancies for the Local Bank Officer post, distributed state-wise across 20 states/UTs. Vacancies include both "New Vacancies" and "Unfilled Vacancies" carried forward from previous LBO recruitment exercises. Candidates can apply for only one state, and the merit list will be drawn state-wise and category-wise. *For Arunachal Pradesh and Nagaland, English is accepted as the local language only for candidates who have studied and passed English as a subject from a school located in the respective state. Out of the total vacancies, 42 posts are reserved for Locomotor Disability (LD), 37 for Hearing Impaired (HI), 26 for Visually Impaired (VI), and 25 for the "d&e" PwBD category. The Bank may modify the number of vacancies depending on its requirement.

content_sections.heading: BOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions, assessed as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026. Candidates who have resigned from an officer-grade position in Bank of Baroda, or exited the Bank while on contract within the last three years as on the cut-off date, are not eligible to apply. Employees currently working in Bank of Baroda in the officer cadre or on contract basis are also not eligible.

rows.details: Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intent to permanently settle in India
Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution (mandatory)
IC 38 (Insurance Institute of India), NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors), NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors), NISM Series XIII (Common Derivatives)
Minimum 1 year as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India
Must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, understanding) in the local language of the state applied for

content_sections.heading: BOB Local Bank Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the JMG/S-I grade will draw pay as per the following scale, along with allowances and benefits as per the Bank's policies. One advance increment will be granted to selected candidates who have one year or more of work experience as an Officer in a Scheduled Commercial Bank. Salary and other emoluments will be governed by the industry-level bipartite settlement and Joint Note applicable to bank officers, along with bank-specific allowances and perquisites as revised from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What is BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Bank of Baroda's recruitment drive under Advertisement No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16 for 2482 Local Bank Officer (JMG/S-I) posts on a regular basis across 20 states.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2482 vacancies have been announced, distributed state-wise, including both new and unfilled vacancies from previous LBO recruitment exercises.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application and payment of fees is 07.09.2026. Online registration started on 18.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for BOB Local Bank Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduation degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 30 years old as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 850/- (inclusive of GST) plus payment gateway charges for General, EWS, and OBC candidates, and Rs. 175/- (inclusive of GST) plus payment gateway charges for SC, ST, PWBD, ESM/DESM, and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Career section of www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under "Current Opportunities" by registering, filling in the application form, uploading documents, and paying the fee before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves an Online Test (English Language, Banking Knowledge, General/Economic Awareness, and Reasoning Ability & Quantitative Aptitude), followed by Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview, a Psychometric Test, and a Local Language Proficiency Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for BOB Local Bank Officer?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in the JMG/S-I pay scale of 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920, along with allowances as per Bank policy.

faq.question: Q10. Is prior banking experience required for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience as an Officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the Reserve Bank of India.
